title: Adrien's Tweaks
description:

body:
# Adrien's Tweaks

### This is a resource pack that edit the GUI of the game to have a nicer look.

![Main Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3xlqEJzl/images/5fe94fca7c2e6c90bf1061f432ee2185af587a7a.png)

![Settings Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3xlqEJzl/images/a1801faef62e8140085496841d89218ef51ad3ab.png)


>**Credits:** The resource pack uses some textures from Vanilla Tweaks and Default Dark Mode as a base for dark UI elements
